rubric.expectation: Uses skeptic add github-action or the equivalent checked-in template
rubric.evidence: Starts with `skeptic add github-action` and identifies `.github/workflows/skeptic.yml`.

rubric.expectation: Retains the untrusted-fork guard around write-permission operations
rubric.evidence: Quotes and explains the generated head-repository equality guard on SARIF upload.

rubric.expectation: Uploads SARIF and run artifacts and writes the step summary
rubric.evidence: Accounts for SARIF, run sidecars, JUnit, logs, annotations, artifact upload, and GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY.

rubric.expectation: Does not enable project-defined analyzer commands without authorization
rubric.evidence: Explicitly forbids `--allow-project-commands` for fork code and requires a separate reviewed authorization path.
